VEF.AnimalGenes.FeratypeFamilyDef.label: cows
VEF.AnimalGenes.FeratypeFamilyDef.description: Descended from the great bovines of Old Earth, this family encompasses hardy grazing animals bred for meat, milk, labor, and other useful traits.

VEF.AnimalGenes.FeratypeFamilyDef.label: pigs
VEF.AnimalGenes.FeratypeFamilyDef.description: Versatile omnivores prized for their rapid growth and efficient conversion of food into meat, with numerous breeds adapted to different forms of husbandry.

VEF.AnimalGenes.FeratypeFamilyDef.label: sheep
VEF.AnimalGenes.FeratypeFamilyDef.description: Herding animals traditionally valued for their fiber and meat, selectively bred into breeds ranging from hardy pasture grazers to specialized producers.

VEF.AnimalGenes.FeratypeFamilyDef.label: boomalope
VEF.AnimalGenes.FeratypeFamilyDef.description: Strange, fire-prone livestock descended from engineered animals, selectively bred for their volatile biology and unusual adaptations.
